title: Cindermoth Cloak

sources.title: Flaming Shroud
markers: | description = A creature that damages the wearer within {{Dist|m=2|ft=7}} receives {{Cond|Burning}}.

summary: Flaming Shroud can Burn a melee attacker for 2 turns if the cloak’s wearer fails a DC 12 Dexterity save.

fields.Base value: 70 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Flaming Shroud: The tooltip describes Burning an attacker within 7 ft. The pinned source reports that only damaging melee attacks trigger it. The wearer rolls a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failed save, the attacker gains Burning for 2 turns.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
